EXPLANATION: The strong band at 2255 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of an aliphatic nitrile C≡N stretch, ruling out azide-bearing (2, 6, 9) and alkyne-containing (3, 7, 8) candidates; the absence of any N–H stretch near 3300 cm⁻¹ disfavors amine-containing 4 and 10. The aliphatic C–H stretches at 2878/2941 cm⁻¹ are consistent with saturated chains (GFQ-003), and the pair of bands at 1127 and 1024 cm⁻¹ aligns with typical ether C–O–C stretching modes. Between the ether–nitrile options, the observed ν(C≡N) at 2255 cm⁻¹ better matches a nitrile not directly α to oxygen (candidate 1) than the α-alkoxy nitrile in 5, which often appears slightly higher. Overall, CCCCOCCC#N (1) best fits the nitrile + ether + aliphatic features.
